selection: all rows with phase=measure, in original order

column_definitions.t_s: Source IMU time rebased to zero at the first exported measure row [s].
column_definitions.motor_snapshot_us: Timestamp of the separately sampled motor state [us].
column_definitions.u_left_steps_per_s: Left wheel STEP frequency command, signed [STEP/s].
column_definitions.u_right_steps_per_s: Right wheel STEP frequency command, signed [STEP/s].
column_definitions.a_cmd_mps2: Longitudinal acceleration command after speed limit, before individual wheel correction [m/s^2].

remarks: Closed-loop balance measurements with the fixed PID configuration recorded in NC_CFG.
u_* and a_cmd are commanded quantities. Actual wheel acceleration is not measured by these columns.
Pitch is an IMU estimate. estimated_v_mps uses the source identified by feedback_id.
Controller data and motor-state data have separate timestamps.
Original timestamps and row order are preserved. No resampling or interpolation is applied.
